svg.aria-label: Results at a glance: semble puts 62% of the needed files in its top 10 (grep 33%); BM25 shows 22% of the needed lines within 8,000 tokens (semble 11%); adding semble or graphify to an agent did not find more files (83% to 85%) but took 32 s and 60 s per session instead of 13 s
